items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: John would say, 'Man, don't ask me that. I work with Art Tatum and Nat Cole.'

ctx.x: Yeah. It goes all the way back. I said -- because I don't think John had a chance to really stretch out, as we call it, because he was working with Nat Cole, King Cole, you know, and he had a thing about his family. He wanted to raise his daughters. So consequently he wanted something pretty stable, you know?

items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: As much as I admire Sarah, Nat King Cole was a complete heavyweight.

ctx.x: And husband, yes, made her late on purpose, to see if she could hold up closing the second half. That meant that if she was absent Nat would have to close the first half. Well, he learned his lesson. As much as I admire Sarah, Nat King Cole was a complete heavyweight.
